Team — quick internal note to align before Neha sends the commercial back: 
- Platform fee: standard one-time platform fee is $75k. For a 36-month committed deal we can amortize and waive up to 50% (i.e., credit $37,500) provided the customer signs the enterprise addendum and a 3-year support contract. If they want a full waiver, we should secure a 48–60 month commit or an elevated MRR minimum.
- Support discount: standard premium support is 18% of ARR; we can offer 20% off premium for 36 months (effective 14.4% of ARR) if they accept a 2x response SLA for non-critical incidents and agree to quarterly operations reviews.
- KMS & SOC2: KMS integration is covered; no charge for standard integrations. SOC2 evidence can be packaged — attach the assertion and SOC2 kit.
- Migration credits: offer a one-time $10k professional services credit if they sign within 30 days.

Ben — confirm whether the three nodes as described are steady-state. If they're burstable, pricing needs a slightly different SKU.
